g.text: New page design board: inherit existing convergence system, add CIO cockpit, three rails, portfolio intelligence, unified workbench.
Do not redraw from scratch. Extend the current Figma component definitions and migration discipline.
02 START HERE - Component System Definitions Added
04 VISIBLE COPY - Arbitra Wealth / Redesign Review Board
Design rule: Layer 1 = existing convergence rules. Layer 2 = PRD 2.0 experience system.
OUTPUT: audit board, reusable baseline rules, PRD 2.0 delta list.
5 text levels max in implementation: caption/body/label/title/metric.
From Report Card To Wealth Cockpit
Reference images imply: black cards, dimensional charts, glowing analytical geometry, compact financial readouts.
Use generated-looking geometry only for data that has deterministic implementation.
ECharts custom series / SVG path grid / Three.js mesh plane
No fake numbers. No generated chart text. Data always owned by code.
Figma can use vector placeholder; dev owns final chart geometry.
Command Dashboard: CIO Decision + Three Rails + Portfolio Intelligence
Do not increase high-beta exposure until cash guardrail and concentration risk are reviewed.
Broker holdings 100% / quote coverage 91% / projection T+0
ECharts custom series / SVG path grid
Implementation note: packed bubble/treemap can be built by d3-hierarchy or ECharts custom series; 3D glow is visual treatment, not data logic.
Conversation is a tool, not the whole product
Ask: compare conservative / neutral / aggressive simulation...
Reusable Component Families Required Before Implementation
Default / hover / selected / loading / empty / partial / blocked / warning / mobile.
Implementation Must Be Presentation-Only For This Redesign
No API input/output changes. No content hierarchy changes. No bespoke drawer shells. 3D charts must be implemented via deterministic data-driven layers.
Chart implementation candidates: ECharts custom series, d3-hierarchy packed bubbles/treemap, SVG paths, Canvas, optional Three.js for true 3D surfaces.
